# vastdata_compute_cluster_control (Resource)

Trigger lifecycle actions on a Compute Cluster (start, stop, certificate rotation, etc.). Because Terraform is declarative, each distinct combination of compute_cluster_id + action represents a single execution intent; changing either field destroys and re-creates the resource, re-triggering the action.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Action to perform. Valid values: start, stop, rotate_leaf_certificates, rotate_service_key, reconcile_create, rotate_base_certificates, metric_viewer_certificates.
- `compute_cluster_id` (Number) ID of the Compute Cluster to act on.

### Optional

- `intermediate_certificate` (String, Sensitive) For rotate_base_certificates: RKE2 intermediate certificate PEM. Must be provided together with root_certificate and intermediate_key.
- `intermediate_key` (String, Sensitive) For rotate_base_certificates: RKE2 intermediate private key PEM. Must be provided together with root_certificate and intermediate_certificate.
- `keep_root` (Boolean) For rotate_base_certificates: if true, keep the existing root certificate and only regenerate intermediate and leaf certificates.
- `root_certificate` (String, Sensitive) For rotate_base_certificates: RKE2 root certificate PEM. Must be provided together with intermediate_certificate and intermediate_key.
